_readme: Jacob’s Griffel tree — DAVID’S MOTHER’S SIDE. A separate family from Basia’s Rapaport export: not one of its 569 files appears in hers. 390 people, 140 families. The people who are David’s own blood — his maternal grandparents and his mother’s twelve brothers and sisters — are ALSO written into people.json, where the archive keeps what it has researched itself. Everything else lives only here.
source: Jacob, Griffel family archive (Ahnenblatt export), received 10 August 2026
